Features:

  • Set up for 4 regions, but can be expanded

  • Allows you to invert masks for more accurate side by side characters

  • Either load a mask or use the mask editor with a simple switch

  • Hand, Face, and Eye detailers

  • Two sets of upscalers:

    • Ultimate Upscaler for last layer refinement

    • Seed VR2 for losless upscaling

  • Massive Post Production Suite
